title: Quarter past and quarter to
examples: Why is it called a quarter?

explain.say: Think of the clock face as a round pizza cut into 4 equal slices. Each slice is a quarter of an hour, 15 minutes! Look at the board: the long hand is on 3, a quarter of the way round. It is quarter past 4.
Past means after. Quarter past 4 means 15 minutes after 4 o'clock. The long hand moved from 12 to 3, one quarter of the circle. See the short hand just past 4?
Another quarter, and the long hand reaches 6. That is 2 quarters, half the circle, so it is half past 4. How many minutes after 4 is it now?
One more quarter, and the long hand is on 9: that is 45 minutes past 4. Only one quarter is left before 5 o'clock, so we say quarter to 5. To means before. See how the short hand is nearly at 5?

Brilliant! Here is quarter to 10: the long hand on 9, the short hand nearly on 10. Quarter to always names the next hour. On a digital clock this is 9 45, nine forty-five. Challenge: what time is quarter past 10?

faq.a: Quarter past means 15 minutes after the hour. The minute hand points to 3, a quarter of the way round the clock.
Quarter to means 15 minutes before the next hour. The minute hand points to 9. Quarter to 5 is the same as four forty-five.

faq.q: Why is it called a quarter?
faq.a: A quarter is one of 4 equal parts. An hour is 60 minutes, and a quarter of 60 is 15, so a quarter of an hour is 15 minutes.

faq.q: Why does quarter to use the next hour?
faq.a: Because it tells you how long is left until that hour. At quarter to 5, there are 15 minutes to go until 5 o'clock.
asks: Why is it quarter to 5 and not quarter to 4?

faq.q: Where does the minute hand point at each quarter?
faq.a: At o'clock it points to 12, at quarter past to 3, at half past to 6, and at quarter to it points to 9.

facts: A quarter of an hour is 15 minutes.
Quarter to 5 is the same time as 4:45.

quiz.say: The minute hand points to 3 and the hour hand is just past 7. What time is it?
quiz.show: The minute hand points to 3 and the hour hand is just past 7. What time is it?
quiz.why: The minute hand on 3 means quarter past, and the hour hand just past 7 makes it quarter past 7.

wrong.0: Quarter to needs the minute hand on 9.
wrong.1: 3 is where the minute hand points; the hour is 7.

quiz.say: Which digital time is the same as quarter to 8?
quiz.show: Which digital time is the same as quarter to 8?
quiz.why: Quarter to 8 is 15 minutes before 8, which is 7:45.
